messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Shopping and Retail" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, webmaster@highwayman.com', 'Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, webmaster@highwayman.com', 'You made a payment of 39.00 GBP for the following items: Skype 3 month subscription', 'YOUR $50 AMAZON PROMOTION EXPIRES IN 48 HOURS', 'Your Apple ID was recently used for the acquisition of "Asphalt8" from the iTunes Store on a computer or another device that had not previously been linked to your Apple ID.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Please take some time to check out the range at http://shop.bigpond.com.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
